$comment: [X2.5] MarkItDown MCP attach spec. Tier-1 first-party-ms (Microsoft-owned). Resolved upstream package = markitdown-mcp (PyPI), launched via uvx (NOT npx). Shape === mcp-specs/_template.json (X2.1). CC0-1.0.
title: Document → Markdown Conversion
description: Convert Office documents, PDFs, images, and audio into clean Markdown via the MarkItDown MCP server.

auth.recipe: no credentials required; conversions run locally in the subprocess.

sample_tools.name: convert_to_markdown
sample_tools.summary: Convert a local file or URI (Office/PDF/image/audio) to Markdown.

known_limitations: Requires `uv` / `uvx` on PATH (Python tooling) rather than Node; the first run resolves the markitdown-mcp package.
Some formats (e.g. audio transcription, image OCR) depend on optional extras that may need extra system dependencies.
Destructive-action audit (X2.18): no destructive tools — conversion is read-only.

client_install.claude_desktop: Add to claude_desktop_config.json mcpServers as `markitdown`: { command: uvx, args: [markitdown-mcp] }.
client_install.cursor: Settings → MCP → Add: name `markitdown`, command `uvx markitdown-mcp`.
client_install.vscode: Add to .vscode/mcp.json servers as `markitdown` (VS Code Insider, MCP preview); requires uv on PATH.
